The purpose of the assessment

About Service
This service is provided by Damage Assessment Centers and allows the applicant to request a damage report for their vehicle for damages not resulting from traffic or criminal accidents. The report is intended solely for personal use or for the use of the entity or individual who owns the vehicle. This report is generally not accepted for financial, insurance, or legal claims that require the damages to be associated with traffic or criminal incidents.
